recipe.title: Corned beef
recipe.notes: This is an Edmonds Cooking recipe.

method.s: Put all ingredients into a saucepan or slow cooker and cover with cold water.
Bring to a simmer and cook, covered, for 30 minutes per 500 g meat, or until tender when tested with a fine skewer.
Let the meat sit in its liquid for 20 minutes, then slice thickly to serve warm.
If serving cold, let it cool in the liquid then remove and slice thinly.
